# VK.com

> > VK is Europe's largest social network with over 100 million users, offering social networking, video sharing, event ticketing (VK Билеты), and community features.

VK provides a comprehensive social media platform with features including people search, authentication, video hosting, community groups, and an integrated ticketing service for concerts and cultural events across Russia. The platform emphasizes browser compatibility and offers extensive support resources.

## Key Topics

- VK social network
- VK Билеты (VK Tickets)
- User authentication and sign-in
- People search and discovery
- Video hosting and sharing
- Concert and event ticketing
- Russian entertainment and culture
- Browser compatibility
- Community support
- Сергей Лазарев (Sergei Lazarev)
- Tutorial and educational content
- FAQ and help resources
- Account registration
- Russian cities (Курск, Рязань, Москва, Саранск)

## Core Platform

- [VK.com | VK](https://vk.com): VK homepage - Europe's largest social network with 100M+ users
- [Your browser is out of date | VK](https://vk.com/account/sign_in): VK sign-in page for user authentication and account access
- [Search people by name and birth year | VK](https://vk.com/people): VK people search - find friends and classmates by name and birth year

## Support and Help
